purpose: Heuristic interpretation guide for PR-AYC-G ICA artifact library. These rules do not classify components with certainty.

expected_features: large event-locked deflection after blink markers
frontopolar/frontal topography if frontal channels exist
ocular_blink.caution: Without dedicated EOG channels, blink labels remain probable, not confirmed.

ocular_saccade.caution: Can overlap with blink or face muscle components.

jaw_temporal_emg.caution: At 125 Hz sampling, true 70-110 Hz EMG proxy is unavailable. Use high-edge proxies cautiously.

neck_shoulder_motion.caution: Movement may manifest as electrode contact artifact, not an independent neural source.

expected_features: slow drift or periodic artifact aligned to breath/sigh markers
respiration_or_sigh.caution: Use Vernier belt stream for actual respiratory phase. ICA alone does not prove respiration.

task_lock_candidate.caution: Do not clean away cognitive task components unless clearly myogenic/ocular/contact artifact.

allowed_claim: This library helps identify subject- and montage-specific artifact candidates for inspection and artifact-matched windowing.
prohibited_claims: ICA proves a component is not brain.
A component removed by this library proves PR-AYC-G.
The library can replace EOG/EMG/respiration/motion sensors.
Scalp low gamma is clean merely because ICA was run.
